title: Ten-Mile Natural Gallery
text: A 5.8 km trail through a gorge of fantastical rock formations, each named: Three Sisters, Turtle, Heavenly Sword, the Elderly Couple. Take the mini-train (38 yuan round trip), walk one way, or hike the full 4-5 hours. The best compromise is train out, walk back.

title: Tianzi Mountain trail - Mountain of the Emperor
text: The northernmost district of the park rises to 1,262 m, with a 5-6 km main trail. Reach it via cable car (7 min, 72 yuan), on foot from Yuanjiajie or by bus plus elevator. Viewpoints: Imperial Brush, Cloud Terrace (fiery sunrises), Western Sea and the Emperor's Garden.

title: Yuanjiajie trail - the floating mountain district
text: This is the Avatar district. The loop trail is 3-4 km and takes 2-3 hours with viewpoints. Reach it via Bailong Elevator (326 m up in 1.5 minutes) or shuttle. Main stops: Avatar Hallelujah viewpoint, First Bridge Under Heaven, Gate to Heaven arch and Ten-Mile Gallery.

title: Golden Whip Stream - the classic walking trail
text: A 7.5 km one-way trail along its namesake stream between cliffs 300-400 m tall, with minimal elevation change - perfect for seniors and children. Highlights include the Jumping Fish Waterfall, the 400 m Golden Whip Pillar, the stream bridge and resident macaques and squirrels.

title: May in Zhangjiajie - rains begin
text: Temperatures of +20 to +27 C, humidity rising as monsoon season starts. Avoid May 1-5 (Labour Day holiday) - Bailong queues stretch 2-3 hours. After May 5 it is one of the best times: maximum greenery, fresh air after rains and powerful waterfalls. Pack a raincoat.
